name: Burleson Plaza
demographics: Burleson Plaza serves a growing suburban family demographic in southern Johnson County, with primary visitors consisting of middle-income households earning $50,000-$85,000 annually. The trade area attracts young families and established homeowners aged 25-54 who prioritize convenience and value-oriented shopping for everyday needs. The center draws from Burleson's expanding residential communities, with shoppers typically making frequent trips for groceries, services, and quick dining options rather than destination shopping experiences.
description: Burleson Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 550 Southwest Wilshire Boulevard in the heart of Burleson, Texas. This accessible retail destination serves the growing communities of southern Johnson County with a practical mix of everyday shopping and service options. The center benefits from its strategic location along a major commercial corridor, providing easy access for residents throughout Burleson and surrounding areas. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Burleson Plaza accommodates the busy schedules of working families and local residents seeking convenient shopping close to home. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its solid 4.4-star rating from over 1,400 reviews, demonstrating consistent service and tenant quality that keeps local shoppers returning for their daily needs.
summary: Burleson Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center serving the Burleson community with convenient everyday retail and services along Southwest Wilshire Boulevard. With strong community ratings and accessible hours, it provides a practical shopping destination for local residents.
